name: Simple Taskbar
description: Turns GNOME Shell's native panel into a configurable taskbar with pinned and running applications, live window previews, Grid Alt-Tab, auto-hide, workspace and monitor filtering, multi-monitor panels, an application volume mixer, and an optional Eleven-style Start Menu. Choose Taskbar, Default GNOME Panel, or Windows XP Theme mode, then customise the panel's position, size, spacing, transparency, colours, item order and behaviour. Some global search results may request that provider-supplied text be copied to the clipboard when activated.
